newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: British climber killed on Matterhorn.
newsitem.headline: British climber killed on Matterhorn.

text.p: A Briton fell to his death while returning from a climb on the Matterhorn on Monday, police in the Swiss canton of Valais said on Tuesday.

The 41-year-old man was returning alone from the area below the so-called "Red Tower" at a height of about 4,100 meters. He fell down the east wall of the Matterhorn to the Furg glacier at about 3,300 meters.
"The man simply slipped," a police spokesman said, adding that the identity of the climber, from Yorkshire, had not yet been disclosed.
